summary: Big club car park; south-west bays back onto trees and park.

drivers.seclusion: Bays back onto dense trees and a park with a playground; nearest mapped dwelling about 40 m away across trees and the car park, and the club building is not a home.
drivers.access_and_room: Open sealed car park with marked bays, entered from the south off Moggill Road; no gate seen. Room to pull in beside the tree edge.
drivers.traffic: Moggill Road is some way off; club traffic at events and evenings.
drivers.convention: Large car park busy with cars through the day; a van would blend in.

flags: Club events may bring evening traffic
Low-lying, about 5 m elevation, no mapped waterway
Slope up to 2.8% along the outline
sun_shade: Large trees shade the south-west edge, mainly from the west and afternoon.

best_section.where: South-west edge of the club car park, bays backing onto trees by the playground
